A BIG WORLD TO EXPLORE

Hide & Seek World

Create a room or join your friends. Each round has a random seeker. Hiders get 30 seconds to run, then the 5-minute chase begins. Each player has a totem that breaks to save them once per round. After it breaks, being touched switches roles!

Move with WASD or arrows. Drag the screen to look around, or use Q/E and R/F. Walk through house doors. Press Space to jump, C near a tree to climb, or H near the pond or bushes to hide. On touchscreens, use the buttons.

You need at least 2 players to start.
